title: D.S. Nakara v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: D.S. Nakara v. Union of India, (1983) 1 SCC 305
content.holding: Artificial cut-off dates that split a homogeneous class of pensioners without rational justification violate Article 14.
content.relevance: Standard authority in service and pension cut-off litigation; distinguish later cases where cut-offs are tied to genuine financial packages.
